paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: pixel-diff two screenshots into diff.png + triptych (pixelmatch) — 像素对比工具
> DeepSeek Harness 插件 · 像素对比 / DSH plugin for pixel-diffing screenshots
对两张已截图做像素 diff，输出 `diff.png`（差异标红）和 `compare-triple.png`（左 A / 中 B / 右 diff 三联图，各自左上角带标签）。**不做截图采集**

- **先用 `normal`** 跑一版；要抓淡灰/白渐变这类低对比差异再升 `high`；`u
